text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I go to check on Tap Dance City, who 
got injured during training—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! See? If I can walk this far, I 
can totally practice—
choice_data_list:
Found you! Let's get back to the infirmary 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, my bad. But I don't want an 
injury like this halting my voyage.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No matter the situation, you set sail and 
push forward— Don't you think that's the 
only way you're gonna seize the biggest 
treasure?
choice_data_list: Even so, you need to rest.

...All right. Let's start moving little by 
little.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...! I can handle this much pain! I'll be 
fine!
choice_data_list:
If that injury gets worse, who's going to 
make that dream come true?

If that injury gets worse, who will make 
that dream come true?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll rest for today. To make my dream 
come true, as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grit her teeth, Tap Dance City returned to 
the infirmary and quietly rested...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you, Trainer! Our destination is 
the training track...!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Phew, *pant*... Finally, the grounds are 
in sight—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Damn it... What a mess. After coming all 
this way, too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Supporting Tap Dance City, who had been 
struck with sudden pain, you helped her to 
the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Tap's Friends
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Tap! Is it okay for you to be moving 
around!? I heard you got seriously 
injured...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, that's an amusing rumor. It was 
just a minor sprain."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
An injury like this won't stop me! I'm 
gonna keep on running until I get my hands 
on the big bucks!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, and all of you tooâ 
everyone follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Tap Dance City trained within 
reasonable limits and made a full recovery 
from her injury earlier than planned.
